Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap + an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached so we can align on milestones, owners, and any blockers. Short version below. Attachment: Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub) and diagram.pdf (architecture diagram stub).

Top-level goals we heard:
- Replace legacy search for clinical notes with Redwood embeddings + reranking to speed clinician workflows
- Live POC with subset of three hospitals, ingest cadence ~daily
- Compliance requirement: SOC2 + in-flight audit evidence for data handling

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Kickoff & scoping — Owner: Jasmine (Redwood) & Oliver (Helix) — Target: 2025-11-07
2) Access & compliance intake — Owner: Helix security (you to nominate) — Target: 2025-11-14 — Dependency: questionnaire responses
3) Integration & POC data sync — Owner: Stephanie (Redwood SE) / Helix infra — Target: begin 2025-11-10 (tentative)
4) POC validation & performance review — Owner: Aditya (AE) + Helix clinical lead — Target: 2025-11-21
5) Procurement & contract review — Owner: Helix procurement + Redwood legal — Target: 2025-11-21

Immediate asks:
- Please confirm the Helix owner for the compliance intake (security contact) by EOD Wed 2025-11-05.
- Confirm whether the POC start on 2025-11-10 is realistic for you.
- Let us know any procurement windows we should plan for (typical lead times).

Next steps from our side: we will update the MAP with any changes you request and send a fresh copy. If agreeable, Aditya will schedule a short 30-min kickoff for next week to lock owners and dates.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
